dz: 越南的Lý王朝由男孩皇帝特伦·泰恩·通克(Trân Thái Tông)入宫而终结了216年,后者是最后一任Lý君主Lý Chiêu Hoàng的丈夫,开始了特伦王朝. [引用需要]
de: The Lý dynasty of Vietnam ends after 216 years by the enthronement of the boy emperor Trần Thái Tông, husband of the last Lý monarch, Lý Chiêu Hoàng, starting the Trần dynasty.[citation needed]
